_comment: The ESDK TestServer Configuration_Set: one Configuration_Entry per
Language_Server (Requirement 9.1). Each entry carries a non-empty branch and
repository, a major version >= 1, and a port in 1..65535 that is unique
FIRST-PASS SCOPE: only Java is available/ready; the other language servers
are parked (tasks 9-10) and are added to this set with unique ports in task
12.1. Keeping only the Java entry here means an end-to-end orchestrator run
launches only the Java Language_Server (task 7 / checkpoint 8).
